fullContentHtml:
CGPSC SSE State Service Exam Mains Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) has released the Result for the CGPSC State Service Mains Exam 2026 on the official website of the CGPSC on 01 September 2026. This recruitment was released for 238 posts. Applications for CGPSC SSE PCS Pre Recruitment 2025 were filled from 01 December 2025 to 30 December 2025. The written examination was conducted on 22 February 2026. Candidates who had qualified for this mains examination can download their CGPSC SSE State Service Exam Mains Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 26 November 2025
  • Application Start Date : 01 December 2025
  • Last Date : 30 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 December 2025
  • Last Date Correction : 31 December 2025 to 02 January 2026
  • Prelim Exam Date : 22 February 2026
  • Prelim Admit Card : 11 February 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 16 to 19 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 24 February 2026
  • Pre Result : 26 March 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 06 – 09 June 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 26 May 2026
  • Mains Result : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, All Candidates from Other State : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, OBC (NCL) hailing from Chhattisgarh : Rs. 300/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
